runtime: API compiled debrief, pruned RSS and actual dataset client/parser/facts imports; Intel capture/controller imports and FFmpeg; web assets and Nginx passed offline
workflow: All named runnable steps from the frozen LegiWatch workflow, including fresh/retired migration rehearsal and Phases 2–5, executed natively

review.reviewer: Codex root; publisher/debrief and scoped dataset operator reviewed; capture recovery corrected after lifecycle review; client-impact independently reviewed by Hermes and root, including server-authored limitations; capture-start and fenced queue deferral reviewed by root

corrections: Catalog qualification, exact dated intake receipts and retained article counts are distinct
Newer failures remain authoritative and both Politico endpoints are represented
Public news filters do not claim client-specific relevance
Elapsed/no-transcript and unresolved transcript dialogs withhold generation with a visible reason
Oversized key-moment summaries withhold the draft instead of silently removing closing qualifications
Untouched source-blocked captures can recover only a newly observed verified source in the ordinary timing window, with fresh probes and locked lifecycle/provenance checks
RSS HTML redirects and unsupported content types have accurate failure reasons
A separately reviewed exact-bill dataset operator preserves quota guards, original archive time and protected bill facts; retrieval and missing-inventory update are separate actions
Future capture jobs wait until five minutes before the fresh official start; unknown scheduled times wait while officially in-progress events can start immediately

Pending capture jobs move earlier and later without mutating leased/terminal work; leased early jobs use an owner/expiry/identity/attempt-guarded deferral which refunds only the scheduling claim and retains prior failures

Review-only client-impact drafts require complete exact retained text, authorized active client context, server-owned citations, independent substantive checking, current evidence/access revalidation and bounded cancellation; no unsupported fallback or persistence

databaseRegression.receiptSelection: Actual application-role query and fixture rollback preserve immutable receipts
